package student

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

type onboardingDraftRepositoryStub struct {
	draft           domain.StudentOnboardingDraft
	finalized       domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult
	err             error
	replaceCommand  repository.StudentOnboardingDraftReplaceCommand
	finalizeCommand repository.StudentOnboardingDraftFinalizeCommand
}

func (stub *onboardingDraftRepositoryStub) GetDraft(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentOnboardingDraft, error) {
	return stub.draft, stub.err
}

func (stub *onboardingDraftRepositoryStub) ReplaceDraft(
	_ context.Context,
	command repository.StudentOnboardingDraftReplaceCommand,
) (domain.StudentOnboardingDraft, bool, error) {
	stub.replaceCommand = command
	return stub.draft, false, stub.err
}

func (stub *onboardingDraftRepositoryStub) FinalizeDraft(
	_ context.Context,
	command repository.StudentOnboardingDraftFinalizeCommand,
) (domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeResult, bool, error) {
	stub.finalizeCommand = command
	return stub.finalized, false, stub.err
}

func TestGetStudentOnboardingDraftReturnsStableEmptyProjection(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	empty, err := domain.EmptyStudentOnboardingDraft(studentID)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	result, err := (GetStudentOnboardingDraft{Drafts: &onboardingDraftRepositoryStub{draft: empty}}).Handle(
		context.Background(), studentID,
	)
	if err != nil || result.Version != 0 || result.StudentID != studentID {
		t.Fatalf("empty draft result=%+v err=%v", result, err)
	}
}

func TestPutStudentOnboardingDraftNormalizesAndHashesStudentOwnedReplacement(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	studentID, requestID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	stored := activeOnboardingDraft(t, studentID, 1, now)
	repositoryStub := &onboardingDraftRepositoryStub{draft: stored}
	direction, known, goalText := " Backend ", []string{}, ""
	_, err := (PutStudentOnboardingDraft{Drafts: repositoryStub, Clock: onboardingClockStub{now: now}}).Handle(
		context.Background(), PutStudentOnboardingDraftInput{
			Schema: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftSchema, StudentID: studentID, RequestID: requestID, ExpectedVersion: 0,
			StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{
				DirectionCode: &direction, KnownStacks: &known, GoalText: &goalText,
			},
		},
	)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	command := repositoryStub.replaceCommand
	if command.StudentID != studentID || command.RequestID != requestID || command.RequestHash == "" ||
		command.Answers.DirectionCode == nil || *command.Answers.DirectionCode != "backend" ||
		command.Answers.KnownStacks == nil || len(*command.Answers.KnownStacks) != 0 || command.Answers.GoalText == nil {
		t.Fatalf("replacement command mismatch: %+v", command)
	}

	other := &onboardingDraftRepositoryStub{draft: activeOnboardingDraft(t, "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", 1, now)}
	_, err = (PutStudentOnboardingDraft{Drafts: other, Clock: onboardingClockStub{now: now}}).Handle(
		context.Background(), PutStudentOnboardingDraftInput{
			Schema: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftSchema, StudentID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
			RequestID: requestID, ExpectedVersion: 0,
			StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{DirectionCode: &direction, KnownStacks: &known, GoalText: &goalText},
		},
	)
	if err != nil || other.replaceCommand.RequestHash == command.RequestHash {
		t.Fatalf("request hash was not student-bound: other=%+v err=%v", other.replaceCommand, err)
	}
}

func TestPutStudentOnboardingDraftRejectsInvalidPartialAnswer(t *testing.T) {
	invalid := "not valid"
	_, err := (PutStudentOnboardingDraft{
		Drafts: &onboardingDraftRepositoryStub{}, Clock: onboardingClockStub{now: time.Now()},
	}).Handle(context.Background(), PutStudentOnboardingDraftInput{
		Schema:    domain.StudentOnboardingDraftSchema,
		StudentID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", RequestID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
		StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftAnswers{PreferredPace: &invalid},
	})
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("invalid partial answer error=%v", err)
	}
}

func TestFinalizeStudentOnboardingDraftBuildsVersionBoundCommand(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 9, 4, 12, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	studentID, requestID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	repositoryStub := &onboardingDraftRepositoryStub{}
	_, err := (FinalizeStudentOnboardingDraft{Drafts: repositoryStub, Clock: onboardingClockStub{now: now}}).Handle(
		context.Background(), FinalizeStudentOnboardingDraftInput{
			Schema: domain.StudentOnboardingFinalizeCommandSchema, StudentID: studentID, RequestID: requestID,
			ExpectedDraftVersion: 3, ExpectedProfileVersion: 2,
		},
	)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	command := repositoryStub.finalizeCommand
	if command.StudentID != studentID || command.RequestID != requestID || command.ExpectedDraftVersion != 3 ||
		command.ExpectedProfileVersion != 2 || command.RequestHash == "" || !command.OccurredAt.Equal(now) {
		t.Fatalf("finalize command mismatch: %+v", command)
	}
}

func activeOnboardingDraft(t *testing.T, studentID string, version int64, now time.Time) domain.StudentOnboardingDraft {
	t.Helper()
	draft, err := domain.NormalizeStudentOnboardingDraft(domain.StudentOnboardingDraft{
		Schema: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftSchema, StudentID: studentID,
		Status: domain.StudentOnboardingDraftStatusDraft, Version: version, CreatedAt: &now, UpdatedAt: &now,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return draft
}
